$comment: The voices characters can be given (Character.tts_voice is a key here). Each says what it is on every text-to-speech service QBL can use, under engines.<service>: for kokoro a voice id or a blend such as "af_bella(2)+af_sky(1)", a speed, and for the theatrical voices a blend that takes a voice away ("am_santa(1.5)-am_michael(0.5)": more Santa than Santa), a lang (the language code to read in, when the voice is borrowed from another language) and a volume; for openai a voice and instructions; for chatterbox the clip it speaks in (a recording kept by the chatterbox container, made from this voice on kokoro the first time it is needed, from clip_lines), an exaggeration and a cfg_weight. flair says how much of a character a voice is: 0 or absent an everyday voice, 1 one with character, 2 a theatrical one (a giant, a pixie, a pantomime villain); voices with flair are chosen first (QL_TTS_FLAIR). A voice with nothing for the service in use borrows the nearest voice that has something (same language, gender, then age). See docs/src/content/docs/developers/voices.md. narrators: the default narrator's voice for each language, for scenarios that do not choose one (Scenario.narrator_voice).

samples.en: Hello, explorer! I'm so glad you're here. Shall we get started?
samples.es: ¡Hola, explorador! Me alegra que estés aquí. ¿Empezamos?
samples.fr: Bonjour, explorateur ! Quel plaisir de te voir ici. On commence ?
samples.it: Ciao, esploratore! Sono felice che tu sia qui. Cominciamo?
samples.pt: Olá, explorador! Que bom que você está aqui. Vamos começar?
samples.hi: नमस्ते, खोजकर्ता! तुम्हारा स्वागत है। चलो शुरू करें?
samples.ja: こんにちは、探検家さん！さあ、始めましょう。
samples.zh: 你好，探险家！我们开始吧。

clip_lines.en: Hello there, explorer! Welcome to the lab. Today we're going to find out why the sky turns orange at sunset, and I could really use your help. Look closely at the light through this glass. Do you see how the colors spread apart? That's the secret! Now, shall we write down what we noticed?
clip_lines.es: ¡Hola, explorador! Bienvenido al laboratorio. Hoy vamos a descubrir por qué el cielo se vuelve naranja al atardecer, y de verdad necesito tu ayuda. Mira con atención la luz a través de este cristal. ¿Ves cómo se separan los colores? ¡Ese es el secreto! Ahora, ¿anotamos lo que hemos visto?
clip_lines.fr: Bonjour, explorateur ! Bienvenue au laboratoire. Aujourd'hui, nous allons découvrir pourquoi le ciel devient orange au coucher du soleil, et j'ai vraiment besoin de ton aide. Regarde bien la lumière à travers ce verre. Tu vois comme les couleurs se séparent ? C'est ça, le secret ! Alors, on note ce qu'on a remarqué ?
clip_lines.it: Ciao, esploratore! Benvenuto in laboratorio. Oggi scopriremo perché il cielo diventa arancione al tramonto, e mi serve proprio il tuo aiuto. Guarda bene la luce attraverso questo vetro. Vedi come si separano i colori? Ecco il segreto! Allora, scriviamo quello che abbiamo notato?
clip_lines.pt: Olá, explorador! Bem-vindo ao laboratório. Hoje vamos descobrir por que o céu fica laranja no pôr do sol, e eu preciso muito da sua ajuda. Olhe com atenção para a luz através deste vidro. Está vendo como as cores se separam? Esse é o segredo! Agora, vamos anotar o que percebemos?
clip_lines.hi: नमस्ते, खोजकर्ता! प्रयोगशाला में तुम्हारा स्वागत है। आज हम पता लगाएँगे कि सूरज ढलते समय आसमान नारंगी क्यों हो जाता है, और मुझे तुम्हारी मदद चाहिए। इस काँच से आती रोशनी को ध्यान से देखो। क्या तुम्हें रंग अलग होते दिख रहे हैं? यही तो राज़ है! चलो, जो देखा उसे लिख लेते हैं?
clip_lines.ja: こんにちは、探検家さん！研究室へようこそ。今日は、夕焼けの空がなぜオレンジ色になるのかを調べます。ぜひ手伝ってください。このガラスを通る光をよく見てください。色が分かれていくのが見えますか？それが秘密なんです！では、気づいたことを書きとめましょうか？
clip_lines.zh: 你好，探险家！欢迎来到实验室。今天我们要弄明白，为什么日落的时候天空会变成橙色，我真的需要你的帮助。仔细看看穿过这块玻璃的光。你看到颜色是怎么分开的吗？这就是秘密！那么，我们把看到的记下来吧？
